comment: T28 (issue #28) — Lighthouse CI budgets for the published surfaces (spec §15 M3: Performance ≥90 desktop / ≥85 mobile, Accessibility ≥90; §16: public form + portfolio). Desktop run; see lighthouserc.mobile.json for the mobile run. The published portfolio URL is appended at runtime by apps/web/e2e/lhci-seed.mjs (registers a user, publishes the designer-portfolio template, writes lighthouserc.desktop.runtime.json). The public FORM plane is the /dev/form-plane-harness page — KNOWN GAP: the /p form route is not landed yet (see apps/web/app/p/[slug]/page.tsx).

collect.comment: The workflow starts `pnpm --filter @formforge/web start` itself and seeds a published document before collecting, so no startServerCommand here (port already bound).

categories:performance.comment: CI-runner relaxation: shared GitHub runners throttle CPU and DB round-trips, so the spec §15 ideal (>=0.90 desktop) is enforced as a realistic gate here; median of 3 runs. Re-verify the ideal budget on production hardware.
